title: Result of sub.start (v1.0)
description: Request args: {"stream", "period_s" within the stream's bounds (TELEMETRY.md section 2), "lifetime_s": 10..600 (default 300)}. The subscription belongs to the transport the request came on (an MQTT one lapses with the session); sending sub.start again renews it. A periodic stream runs at the shortest period any subscriber asked for, and the first event follows at once. An event stream (observations) has no period: period_s is refused with no-period and reported as null. An unknown stream is invalid with error unknown-stream.
